text:
deploy-bot: ✅ Release v1.18.3 deployed to prod-usw. Running post-deploy smoke tests now (kvprobe, synth-tts, embed-route). Initial summary: kvprobe OK, synth-tts p95 spiked to ~120ms for a short window. Opening thread to coordinate.

sam: saw the p95 bump on grafana. is that from our synthetic or real traffic? any quick repro? @liz @maria

liz: looks synthetic-first. I ran a couple of live requests against /api/synth/tts and got intermittent 503s + timeouts.

maría: tailing tts-worker logs now (joining). any synthetic payloads saved?

deploy-bot: synthetic sample used: {"voice":"en_us_standard","text":"quick smoke hello"} — reproducer below.

deploy-bot: ```
# quick repro
curl -X POST https://api.prod-usw.redwood.ai/api/synth/tts \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"voice":"en_us_standard","text":"quick smoke hello"}' -v
```

liz: when I hit the endpoint I saw gateway logs: `Timeout writing response to client` + a few 502s from kernel pool.

kevin: could be the new batcher config in this release (`continuous-batch-size=64`) pushing latency on short requests. staging didn't show it though.

rachel: heads up I had canary at 50% for this push. do we want to throttle back while we triage? :thinking:

sam: +1 to throttle back. if this affects tail latency we should reduce blast radius. I can adjust routing.

maria: agree. pinning suggestion: route /api/synth/* to model-variant `v2-fp16` for now and keep kvprobe on current path.

liz: proposed steps: 1) reduce canary -> 10% 2) pin synth route to v2-fp16 3) rerun synth smoke 4) observe 15m.

sam: doing step 1 now (rolling canary to 10%). pausing autoscaler for synth pool while we watch.

deploy-bot: Canary adjusted to 10%. Routing pin created for synth -> v2-fp16. Post-change synthetic smoke started.

deploy-bot: Post-change metrics (t+45s): synth-tts p95 ~48ms, error rate back to baseline. continuing to monitor for 15m.

kevin: logging a note — follow-up item to validate batching heuristics for small payloads; if this recurs we should default `continuous-batch-size=16` for short sequences.

maria: filing incident ticket INC-2026-312 with attached logs + heap of sampled traces. I'll own deeper triage (kernel selection, network jitter, batching). cc @kevin

rachel: thanks all. action items clear. if anything spikes again we rollback fully for synth route.

liz: small nit — add an eval run to the release notes: "TTS smoke: baseline p95 45-55ms" so future bursts are easy to spot.

deploy-bot: noting release-note item and closing thread in 30m if stable :thumbsup:

sam: thanks folks, keeping eyes on dashboards.
